title: Q7 crisis no-death-spiral gate remains manual-only — zero automated enforcement (W3 residual, claimed addressed)
evidence:
harness/econ.odin:
		if stats.crises >= 1 && stats.dots_during_crisis == 0 {
			fmt.println("  FAIL: no dot landed while the crisis was active — the floor did not speak under crisis (the Q7 death-spiral seam)")
			fails += 1
		}
harness/main.odin:101:
		code := econ_check(&cat)
grep across the repo: econ_run_scenario/econ_check have no callers outside harness/econ.odin and harness/main.odin; harness/econ.odin contains no @(test) proc — `odin test harness` (the CI leg) runs exactly 2 tests, both in a11y_oracle_test.odin.
detail: r3 W3 flagged the crisis-stall gate as manual-only; the delta reworked its semantics (dots_during_crisis) but it still executes only via the manual `harness econ-check` verb — a death-spiral regression turns nothing red in CI.
recommended_fix: Add an @(test) in harness that runs the crisis-stall scenario via econ_run_scenario and asserts its four verdicts (crises>=1, floor<=interval<=base, dots_during_crisis>=1), so `odin test harness` enforces Q7.

title: Balance fail-fast table's vacuity guard survives B1 unfixed: any non-balance.json rejection still silently passes every row
evidence:
cerr := catalogs_load(cat, &src)
	if cerr.file != "balance.json" {
		testing.expectf(t, cerr.file != "", "expected a balance.json rejection (rule %q), got %q %q", want_rule, cerr.file, cerr.rule)
		return
	}
	testing.expectf(t, strings.contains(cerr.rule, want_rule),
		"rejection rule: got %q want substring %q", cerr.rule, want_rule)
detail: B1's vacuity was exactly this branch: a rejection from an earlier file (crises.json) with a non-empty name passes. CRISES_VALID repairs today's data, but any future pre-balance source regression re-neuters the whole table with zero signal.
recommended_fix: Make the cerr.file != "balance.json" branch fail hard (expectf(t, false, ...) naming the offending file/rule) so a row can only pass via a genuine balance.json rejection.

title: New dot_interval_ticks 20000 ceiling has no at-boundary rows (20000 loads-clean / 20001 rejects unpinned)
detail: Only a deep out-of-bound value (25000) is pinned; neither the inclusive edge (20000 must load clean) nor the first rejection (20001) is tested, so an off-by-one in the bound ships green.
recommended_fix: Add rows for dot_interval_ticks 20001 (must reject) and a positive row loading 20000 clean (the comment names the advance block's 20000 precedent — pin the edge the same way).

title: crises_resolved counter written but never read — unused instrumentation in the crisis scenario
evidence:
harness/econ.odin:44:
	crises_resolved: i32, // internal: Crisis_Resolved events seen
harness/econ.odin:96:
			if e.tag == pp.EVENT_TAG_CRISIS_RESOLVED do stats.crises_resolved += 1
grep: no other reference to crises_resolved in the repo.
detail: The counter has no consumer; the crisis-stall gate asserts a crisis fires and dots land during it, but never that crises RESOLVE — an ever-stuck crisis would pass the current verdicts.
recommended_fix: Add a crisis-stall verdict `stats.crises >= 1 && stats.crises_resolved < stats.crises` failing when a triggered crisis never resolved, or drop the dead field.
